title: rubus longepedicellatus
intro: Rubus longepedicellatus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species in the rose family that is native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and inflammation, due to its health benefits in reducing oxidative stress and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rubus longepedicellatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ellagic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
